content.title: Shared Shelter | A Prop-Bearing Helper Creates a Bond
content.summary: Expose one waiting subject to a readable environmental pressure, then introduce a smaller helper carrying an active shelter. Use the shelter boundary as a progress indicator, cover both subjects before any affection, and close on one restrained contact inside the shared refuge.

quick_start.input_format: waiting subject exposed to clear environmental pressure + helper enters carrying an activated shelter with visible boundary + single-axis approach until both share one protected area + protection completes before emotion + one restrained contact confirms the bond while pressure remains visible
quick_start.recommended_input: A cream service robot waits beside a broken charging post as amber dust crosses an open platform. A small inspection cart approaches under a fabric canopy; once both are covered, its magnetic side panel connects gently to the robot and they hold still.
required_anchors: Establish one waiting subject, one visible environmental pressure and an uncovered state before help arrives.
Let the active protective prop enter before or with the helper and keep its coverage boundary visible.
Complete protection before using an affiliative gesture.
Use exactly one restrained contact and hold while pressure remains outside the cover.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Expose one waiting subject to a readable environmental pressure, then introduce a smaller helper carrying an active shelter. Use the shelter boundary as a progress indicator, cover both subjects before any affection, and close on one restrained contact inside the shared refuge.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.

not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one original waiting subject exposed to a clearly visible environmental pressure and a readable nearby shelter boundary. Introduce a second original subject carrying one active protective prop; let the prop enter early and keep its coverage edge visible as the helper closes distance. Complete the practical action first by placing both subjects inside one shared protected zone, then add exactly one restrained affiliative gesture such as a nuzzle, hand squeeze or shoulder lean. Hold the final shared shelter while the pressure remains visible outside. The reusable mechanism is exposed waiting state, prop-first helper entrance, coverage-as-progress, practical protection before affection and one-contact bond confirmation—not the source puppy, kitten, red umbrella, porch, rain, fur, exact poses, camera, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish one waiting subject, one visible environmental pressure and an uncovered state before help arrives.
invariants.purpose: Makes the practical need immediately readable.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without exposure, the protective prop has no function.

invariants.rule: Let the active protective prop enter before or with the helper and keep its coverage boundary visible.
invariants.purpose: Turns the solution into a visual promise and progress measure.
invariants.ablation_failure: A hidden prop makes the approach semantically weak.

invariants.rule: Close distance on one legible axis until both subjects occupy the same protected zone.
invariants.purpose: Converts approach into a completed practical action.
invariants.ablation_failure: Random cutting can conceal whether protection was actually shared.

invariants.rule: Complete protection before using an affiliative gesture.
invariants.purpose: Lets care arise from action rather than sentimental decoration.
invariants.ablation_failure: Affection before shelter weakens the causal story.

invariants.rule: Use exactly one restrained contact and hold while pressure remains outside the cover.
invariants.purpose: Confirms the bond and proves the new state.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated gestures or removing the pressure turns the ending into generic cuteness.

the source approach, framing, positions, lick, final pose and 15-second timing
the source creator identity, MiniMax H3 claim, watermark and wording
